notes: #3 (Hatfield engraving of the river front with Catherine II’s palace, about 1787) is more detailed but small (852 px) and its making date is uncertain; it is an alternate for P3. #7 (western part of the city from a height, black and white) is an alternate for P4. #5 is dated 1905–17 on Commons; postcards of this type are usually before 1914. #14 shows Sadky village, not the city; #15 is mostly river.
